channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bennedict Mathurin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bennedict Mathurin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darius Garland on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Darius Garland on Bennedict Mathurin:

“He has no fear. I didn’t know he was that creative with the ball in his hands…In Indiana he was aggressive, but over here T-Lue and everybody is letting him rock out. I really like it… Ben is gonna be Ben. We really need him to go be Ben. I love the aggression. I didn’t see it in Indiana but I love it over here.”

Darius Garland on Bennedict Mathurin, Mar 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Tony East:Rick Carlisle on defense in the final minutes:

“McConnell, Nembhard, Mathurin, these guys did a great job defensively tonight. Mathurin's defense has taken a real step forward this year. He's taken matchups, he did a really great job on Giddey... this is part of the growth process.”

Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin, Nov 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin:

“I’ll break the news right here:I’m projecting him as our starter at two this year. I’ve told him this. I was on the phone with him and his agent four days ago and I said, ‘You’re going to be with the starters on day one. It’s your job to lose.'”

Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin, Aug 5, 2025. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Bennedict Mathurin:

“He seems to have a game like this every series. He’s a talented player.. Those guys [Mathurin and McConnell] were catalysts. You tip your hat to them.”

Mark Daigneault on Bennedict Mathurin, Jun 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Lu Dort on Bennedict Mathurin:

“Ben is kinda a brother to me, honestly. Grew up in the same neighborhood. Our people know each other. We spend a lot of time together during the offseason.”

Luguentz Dort on Bennedict Mathurin, Jun 1, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin:

“He's a confident young man. He's tough. He's legitimately tough. In a tough playoff series against a tough opponent like this, he fits in games like this.”

Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin, May 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin:

“He's ready to play. We're going to need himand it's pretty much as simple as that.”

Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin, May 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Carlisle:

“Aaron Nesmith and Pascal Siakam are great examples for Jarace Walker, Ben Sheppard, Ben Mathurin.... Pascal has earned his position in this league, two-time All-Star, two-time All-NBA. Aaron Nesmith has earned his spot on our team.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle said.

“Bruce playing with Drew is as good as we got as far as defense in the backcourt, and I thought Mathurin was terrific. It looked like a replay of the Milwaukee game.”

Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin, Nov 25, 2023. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Buddy Hield on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Buddy Hield on Pacers teammate Bennedict Mathurin:

“He’s a confident guy. He works hard. … He’s one of those guys that has a whole chip on his shoulder, and it comes from a good place, you know? He’s always hard on himself. He puts a ton of work in. Every time I go to the gym, he’s in there putting extra work in, watching film and talking to coaches. He’s one of those guys that are going to continue to get better in this league, and he’s just a rookie. The numbers that he's putting up and the things he’s doing are very impressive. He has a long way to go, a lot to learn about the game, but where he is at right now? I’m speechless.”

Buddy Hield on Bennedict Mathurin, Jun 28, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Indiana Pacers coach Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin:

“Mathurin has a veteran-type toughness and consistency and belief. The reason why he believes so strongly in his game is because he works so hard on his game. He’s getting better and better. The way he’s playing and the positions that he’s putting himself and his teammates in are showing great growth.”

Rick Carlisle on Bennedict Mathurin, Jun 28, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Lu Dort on Bennedict Mathurin:

“He’s a bucket. And he’s been like that. I told him if you’re able to score on me, you’re gonna crush it at Arizona. (Laughs).”

Luguentz Dort on Bennedict Mathurin, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on the trash talk with Indiana and the face-to-face, chest-to-chest tie-up with rookie Bennedict Mathurin in the fourth quarter:

“Sometimes you just have to ... (pauses because he knows it's going to sound corny) ... let 'em know.”

Donovan Mitchell on Bennedict Mathurin, Dec 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.
